scope: Actual polynomial reduced-pair universe overF3 with f=X^(24t+5)+1,g=12t+2. Unique normalized addition-by-(X,1) runs, exact24t+5cycles and unequal smooth fractions. No all-pair ambient group law or geometric Picard identification assumed or proved.
statement: Over F3, for every t, f=X^(24t+5)+1 is monic/separable of degree2g+1,g=12t+2. Its finite set of all valid reduced pairs contains n=24t+5 distinct smooth pairs. Normalized addition by(X,1) has a unique certified output at every indexed pair and actual step returns afterj iff n dividesj. Orbit smooth fraction1 exceeds ambient smooth fraction by an explicit uniform nonsplit pair. Genus and period are unbounded.
